Dual-trope — מ:כפול (plain format)

← Back to Reading MAM-parsed-plain

This template encodes a dually-accented content and its corresponding singly-accented “strands.” Used in three sections with dual cantillation: the two Decalogues (Exodus 20, Deuteronomy 5) and the Saga of Reuben (Genesis 35:22).

{
  "stmpl": "מ:כפול|כפול=לְשֹׂנְאָֽ֑י׃|א=לְשֹׂנְאָֽי׃|ב=לְשֹׂנְאָ֑י"
}

Named parameters:

Param Description
כפול The content with dual trope (as found in the great codexes)
א First singly-accented strand (for Reuben: פשוטה; for Decalogues: תחתון cantillation)
ב Second singly-accented strand (for Reuben: מדרשית; for Decalogues: עליון cantillation)
